text: The benchmark suite is the cargo project `benchmarks/` on dev since `cc10d11`. From `benchmarks/`: `cargo run --release -- [NAME]`, 4 threads, 5 runs and 10 MiB fixtures by default, NAME a benchmark in `benchmarks/src/bench.rs` such as normal, long-n or mask-dna, or a prefix such as mask. It builds this tree unless `--bin label=PATH` is given; `--compare-to` adds one binary beside it. A first unrecorded run stops if two binaries write different output, so a change that moves the bytes is timed by hand.
